item: The Merge's row reader refuses malformed uploads with a 400 and a plain reason instead of a 500
key_paths: src/catalog/qualification_merge.py; tests/test_qualification_merge_action.py; tests/test_overlay_editor.py; src/api/source_management.py; src/catalog/qualification_integrity.py; src/database/connect.py; docs/ledger/OPEN_QUEUE.md; docs/product/RELEASE_0.4_GATE.md
summary: An impossible YAML date, a 100,000-deep opening bracket (JSON, YAML, or a bundle member), a bundle member with a corrupt deflate stream, an integer past Python's digit limit, a bundle member that is not UTF-8, a damaged zip directory and a verdicts list holding non-mappings (skipped and counted) no longer escape the reader as 500s (they were not caught: only YAMLError and BadZipFile were); the refusals use the existing frames with fixed words, never the library's message, so no upload text is echoed; the flag readers are hardened the same way; each case has a test that fails on the old code. Also: the overlay editor's imported-curated half is pinned by a test, three docstrings name all the refusal reasons or the fourth probe user, the #1316 shipped row regained its comma, the gate's own-backup sentence carries the rebuild qualifier, the O5 observation is queued in OPEN_QUEUE (not fixed), and reencrypt_plain_to no longer names the removed replace-restore path.
